info.name: Roboo — Mobile API
info.description:
Mobile surface of the Roboo API: student app plus the teacher app.

**Admin routes are deliberately not here.** They live behind `/api/admin/*` and belong to the web dashboard, not the mobile client.

## Running it
1. `Auth > Login (Student)` — stores `{{token}}`.
2. `Auth > Login (Teacher)` — stores `{{teacher_token}}`.
3. Everything else can then run in any order. The teacher folders create and then delete their own data, so a full run leaves nothing behind.

Point `base_url_app` at a local server to run against development.
